subject: Walkthrough timing — move to post-capex rebaseline
messages:
From: Sam Walters <sam.walters@clearfieldhealth.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@clearfieldhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Aug 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to pause walkthrough until capex rebaseline

Hi Maya,

Quick note from our side — we need to pause the scheduled product walkthrough. Our finance and exec team just kicked off an urgent FY rebaseline and the capex committee asked us to hold all vendor demos that could influence spend until they complete the review (expected ~2 weeks, maybe longer).

I know we were aiming for Aug 12th; that won't work now. Can we tentatively move your walkthrough to the week after their rebaseline? I can confirm a solid window once the committee shares dates.

Apologies for the churn — Priya (our procurement lead) is looped here for timing and PO questions. We still want to move forward, just need the demo to sit after the committee clears.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Walters
Head of Infrastructure Programs
Clearfield Health
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Walters <sam.walters@clearfieldhealth.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@clearfieldhealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 06 Aug 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to pause walkthrough until capex rebaseline

Hi Sam — thanks for the heads up. Totally understand — the rebaseline makes sense.

Two quick things from our side:
- We can hold the demo and tentatively propose Aug 26–28 as a follow-up window (we'll keep it flexible).
- If it helps the committee, I can prepare a 1-page cost estimate and a short procurement checklist that lays out billing model, SOC2 evidence, and timeline for PO issuance. Should I send those to Priya and the committee?

Aditya (cc'd) — can you confirm whether we can bind a temporary credit extension for Clearfield until PO clears? That usually helps keep pilots moving.

Sam — once you have an estimated committee close date, ping me and we'll lock an exact 60–75 minute slot. Happy to record a short condensed walkthrough for the exec review if they prefer a briefing rather than a full demo.

—Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@clearfieldhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Clearfield — hold, credits, and procurement artifacts

Maya / Laura — looping to coordinate before we reply to Priya. Summary: Clearfield's capex committee paused demos and may push the walkthrough until after their FY rebaseline (Sam estimated ~2 weeks but could slip). Priya is procurement contact and asked for vendor docs.

Proposed plan: 
1) Offer a 30-day pilot credit extension (no PII/data movement until they sign PO). That buys us runway.
2) Prepare a one-pager cost/consumption estimate and a procurement checklist (SOC 2 report, data residency notes, estimated start date post-PO). I can draft the cost sheet — Maya you can add runtime/latency SLO notes.
3) Send procurement artifacts as attachments and propose three dates in the week of Aug 26–29 for a recorded executive walkthrough plus a technical deep-dive slot the following week.

Laura — can you attach the latest MAD-POC deck and the Procurement_RFI.xlsx (we keep those in the sales drive)? If you can't access, I'll pull them.

If procurement needs a DocuSign/PO template, we can provide a sample and a HubSpot link to the SOW (no signature required yet).

Thanks — Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@clearfieldhealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to pause walkthrough until capex rebaseline

On Tue, Aug 19, 2025 at 09:10 AM Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Maya / Laura — looping to coordinate before we reply to Priya. Summary: Clearfield's capex committee paused demos and may push the walkthrough until after their FY rebaseline (Sam estimated ~2 weeks but could slip). Priya is procurement contact and asked for vendor docs.

Thanks, Aditya — that plan sounds good. A 30-day credit extension would definitely make the finance team more comfortable while the PO runs through legal and our purchasing platform.

Regarding timing: CFO travel means the committee will likely convene on Aug 25–26 and sign-offs should land the week of Aug 26 (so Aug 28–29 for an exec walkthrough is realistic). Please send the one-pager and procurement checklist today so I can attach them to the committee packet. Also include the MAD-POC deck and RFI spreadsheet — I will circulate internally.

A couple of asks for Redwood before we rebook:
- A concise cost estimate with expected monthly token spend ranges and any additional infra fees.
- An outline of what Redwood needs from Clearfield to start a pilot (contacts, expected data sources, network/KMS notes).

If you can send those by EOD PST, I'll include them in the packet and confirm a time for Aug 28 for an exec-level 30-minute briefing. Procurement will follow with a PO template (we use DocuSign).

Best —
Priya Rao
Director, Procurement Operations
Clearfield Health

Attachments referenced: MAD-POC-Deck.pdf, Procurement_RFI.xlsx
